guitar.evidence: Garth Brooks plays acoustic rhythm guitar live but is primarily a vocalist; no documented signature instrument.

tone.target: bright country-rock clean with light crunch
tone.profile: bright country-rock clean with light crunch
tone.summary: A classic country-rock setup utilizing a clean US Deluxe amp model paired with light compression and a focused cab to achieve the required brightness and punch for rhythm playing.
corrections: keep it cleaner than classic crunch

rig.name: Garth Brooks - Friends In Low Places - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a tight rhythm feel.
Provide consistent dynamics and punch for tight strumming.
Add slight grit and harmonic richness on accents without heavy distortion.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is a general choice for light breakup, simulating the desired 'slight grit' of classic country-rock tones.

alternatives.reason: Could also provide light crunch but might be slightly warmer.

blocks.purpose: Bypass to maintain clean signal path.
blocks.gap: No dedicated saturation module is needed; the Green OD handles the required grit.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, clean Fender-style amp required for country-rock.
Provide a bright, focused cabinet sound matching the Fender aesthetic.
Enhance the clear top end and cut unnecessary low-end mud.
Bypass to keep the tone dry and focused on rhythm.
blocks.gap: The verdict explicitly avoids complex modulation effects like Chorus or big delay.

blocks.purpose: Bypass to maintain a dry mix.
blocks.gap: The verdict specifies avoiding big delay and keeping the tone dry.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle, natural room ambience without sounding overly wet or dark.
blocks.gap: A very low mix of Room reverb is used to provide depth while adhering to the 'dry mix' requirement.

alternatives.reason: Could be used, but Room better suits a natural country-rock setting.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and high-end clarity for the country-rock genre.

proposals.reason: Enhance natural, bright acoustic character needed for Garth Brooks style.
